description:
About the job

Prospecting & Lead Generation Specialist (B2B, Apollo & Sales Navigator Expert) - 100% Remote




Apply here: https://wisevas.io/work-with-us




Are you experienced in building targeted prospect lists and running cold outbound campaigns from start to finish? Do you know how to use LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar platforms to identify the right decision-makers and turn cold prospects into qualified conversations?




We're looking for a Prospecting & Lead Generation Specialist to support a fractional CFO firm serving founder-led businesses across real estate, professional services, and technology-enabled companies. This is a hands-on outbound prospecting role, not an account management, customer success, or general administrative position.




About the Role

You'll be responsible for building and maintaining targeted prospect lists, executing cold outreach through LinkedIn and email, managing multi-touch follow-up sequences, qualifying responses, and booking discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.




This role is ideal for someone who has personally built lead lists, researched prospects, run outbound sequences, and managed the prospecting process end-to-end. You won't be responsible for pitching or closing deals — your focus is creating a consistent pipeline of qualified opportunities.




The position is approximately 20 hours per week, fully remote, with some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.




Responsibilities

Build and maintain targeted B2B prospect lists based on a defined Ideal Client Profile (ICP).
Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify companies, decision-makers, and qualified prospects.
Use Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence platforms for list building, prospect research, and contact enrichment.
Run cold outbound campaigns through LinkedIn and email.
Build and execute consistent multi-touch outreach and follow-up sequences.
Personalize outbound messaging based on prospect and company research.
Qualify inbound responses generated through outbound campaigns.
Book qualified discovery calls directly into the founder's calendar.
Maintain accurate and organized prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
Track lead status, outreach activity, follow-ups, and pipeline progression.
Report weekly on outreach volume, response rates, engagement, and booked discovery calls.
Continuously refine targeting, lists, and outreach execution based on campaign performance.
Take ownership of the outbound prospecting process with minimal day-to-day supervision.




What We're Looking For

2–3+ years of proven experience in lead generation, B2B prospecting, cold outreach, SDR, BDR, or a similar outbound-focused role.
Real, hands-on experience building prospect lists from scratch, not simply working leads already provided by a company.
Someone who has personally built target lists and run outbound sequences in Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar
Hands-on experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator, including building, filtering, and saving targeted lead searches.
Experience using Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar sales intelligence and lead enrichment platforms.
Proven experience personally executing cold email and LinkedIn outreach sequences.
Strong understanding of outbound sequencing, follow-up cadence, prospect research, and lead qualification.
Ability to identify the right companies and decision-makers based on an ICP.
Experience maintaining lead pipelines and prospect data in Excel, spreadsheets, or CRM systems.
Excellent written English, with the ability to write professional outbound messages.
Highly organized, self-directed, and comfortable working independently.
Results-oriented mindset with an understanding of outbound metrics such as outreach volume, response rates, engagement rates, and booked meetings.
Experience prospecting into real estate, property management, professional services, or B2B financial services is a strong plus.
Availability for some daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.




Do NOT Apply If

Your background is primarily in Account Management, Customer Success, or Customer Service without significant cold prospecting experience.

You are uncomfortable being measured on outreach volume, response rates, engagement, and booked discovery calls.

title: Growth & Customer Success Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Growth & Customer Success Specialist en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y nuestro negocio de pagos (POS y online) crece fuerte. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar — y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con orientación a resultados, disciplina de seguimiento y calle para moverse en terreno, que entienda que cada comercio que crece con nosotros es una relación que construimos.




📍 Modalidad presencial / híbrida – base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.




Tu desafío: Hacer crecer el uso de nuestros medios de pago dentro de la cartera de comercios que ya son clientes (modelo LAND/EXPAND). No es cazar clientes nuevos: es que los que ya tenemos transaccionen más con nosotros.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Gestión activa de cartera: contacto proactivo y sostenido con los comercios de alto valor, con revisión de métricas de procesamiento por merchant.

• Subir la penetración GPV/GMV: mover a cada comercio sobre el umbral (≥50%) y empujarlo hacia 60% / 70%.

• Diagnosticar la fricción (técnica, UX, preferencia por competidor, desconocimiento de features) y resolver o escalar los obstáculos de procesamiento.

• Anti-arbitraje: detectar comercios que usan el split de boleta pero procesan la tarjeta en un POS de la competencia, y actuar sobre ello.

• Intervenir cuando las cuentas caen bajo el umbral o muestran señales de fuga.

• Aplicar pricing táctico dentro de los guardrails definidos.

• Recibir los comercios recién vendidos/activados y asumir la relación de crecimiento, coordinando con los hunters sin competir en la venta.

• Escalar necesidades de producto al PM.

• Alimentar los dashboards de penetración, GPV por cuenta y arbitraje, y participar en los ritmos semanales del equipo de Payments.




Requerimientos: 

• Formación en Administración de Empresas, Mercadotecnia, Ingeniería Industrial o carrera afín.

• Base en Ciudad de México, con disponibilidad para visitar comercios.

• 2–4 años en account management / KAM / customer success o gestión de cartera B2B, idealmente en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Orientación a GPV (volumen procesado), no a número de llamadas; track record de crecer revenue/engagement en cartera existente, no solo adquisición.

• Capacidad de leer data y dashboards, identificar patrones y priorizar comercios por oportunidad.

• Comunicación empática pero directa; cómodo visitando comercios y teniendo conversaciones difíciles.

• Autonomía y disciplina de seguimiento; trabaja en equipo con los hunters y activación sin competir (roles complementarios).




Suma puntos:

• Experiencia en medios de pago, servicios financieros, SaaS o tecnología para comercios.

• Experiencia en el sector belleza, salud o bienestar.

• Conocimiento del ecosistema de pagos mexicano (Clip, Mercado Pago, Getnet, Netpay, bancos adquirentes)

About the job

Descripción de la empresa

Se espera que el sector Automotriz del grupo Continental se convierta en una empresa independiente bajo el nombre de “AUMOVIO” en septiembre de 2025. Con aproximadamente 93,000 empleados en todo el mundo y ventas anuales de alrededor de 20 mil millones de euros, estamos entrando en una nueva y emocionante era.

AUMOVIO representa productos electrónicos altamente desarrollados y soluciones modernas de movilidad. Además de su sólida posición en el mercado con soluciones innovadoras de sensores, pantallas, sistemas de freno y confort tecnológicamente avanzados, AUMOVIO cuenta con una experiencia significativa en software, plataformas de arquitectura y sistemas de asistencia para el mercado en rápido crecimiento de vehículos definidos por software y autónomos. Nuestro propósito es claro: hacer que la movilidad del futuro sea segura, emocionante, conectada y autónoma.

Ayudar en el desarrollo del sistema de reconocimiento a empleados por su participación en mejora continua

Ser estudiante activo con al menos un año restante para concluir la carrera en Diseño Grafico, Mercadotecnia o carreras afines.
Contar con seguro facultativo o médico mayor vigente.

Nivel de Ingles B1.

Compromiso.
Iniciativa.
Capacidad autodidacta.
Trabajo en equipo
Comunicación asertiva.

Información adicional

En AUMOVIO estamos comprometidos con la construcción de un ecosistema incluyente y libre de discriminación en México, estos principios se encuentran asentados en nuestra filosofía y cultura corporativa. Por lo cual, queda totalmente prohibido solicitar prueba de embarazo o VIH como parte de nuestros procesos de selección.

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn’t just anyone’s job. Make it yours!  Join AUMOVIO. Own What’s Next.

description:
About the job

Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

We operate with an AI-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.

If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

Purpose

The overall purpose of a Senior MM Customer Growth Executive/Customer Growth Executive role is to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and growth for Tier 1 /Tier 2 clients. This involves building strong relationships, understanding client needs, coordinating internal resources, and continuously developing strategies to enhance client engagement and business outcomes.

The Customer Growth Executive is essential for nurturing and growing relationships with Tier 1/Tier 2 clients, ensuring their satisfaction and retention while driving business growth. This role requires a strategic focus on client advocacy, performance metrics, effective account management, internal coordination, and continuous personal and team development. By excelling in these areas, the Customer Growth Executive contributes to the company's overall success and competitive positioning in the market.

Success Metrics


 Gross Profit and Margin Percentage


Gross Profit: Measures the profitability of services provided to clients.

Margin Percentage: Indicates the efficiency in generating profit from sales.


 Net Revenue Retention (NRR)


Reflects the revenue retained from existing clients, including upsells, expansions, and churn, demonstrating client satisfaction and growth.


 Client Retention Rate


The percentage of clients retained over a specific period, indicating the success in maintaining ongoing relationships.


 Product and Service Adoption Rates


Measures the frequency and extent of clients using the company’s products and services, including the adoption rate of new features, showing client engagement and satisfaction.


 Cross-Sell/Up-Sell Gross Profit

Analyze and forecast client's traffic, take immediate reactions to ensure ongoing business growth, minimize losses, and maximize GP/revenue.

Coordinate internal teams to timely fulfill client's requirements (Customer Success, Sales Engineers, Customer Support, CPaas Registrations, Platform Operations, Customer Analyst, Procurement, Revenue Assurance).

Why you'll love it here

 Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.

title: Email & SMS Specialist / Associate
skills: Build & Template Management
Build campaigns and flows using Klaviyo’s drag-and-drop editor, working from approved templates and brand style guides
Make template edits in Figma for image swaps, copy revisions, and minor layout adjustments prior to setup in Klaviyo
Maintain a template library per brand to speed up future builds
Build and update SMS/MMS campaigns and flows in Postscript, Attentive or Klaviyo
Project Management of Production
Manage creative requests and revisions between clients and internal design/copy teams, tracking status from brief through final approval
Keep creative assets organized and version-controlled so the correct final files are used at deployment
Flag timeline risks (late assets, pending approvals) that could delay scheduled sends
Deployment Management
QA every send against a standardized checklist: link accuracy, send times, personalization tags, UTMs, subject line/preview text, and mobile vs. desktop rendering
Schedule and deploy campaigns and flow updates across multiple client accounts on a shared editorial calendar
Manage send-time conflicts and suppression logic across concurrent campaigns/flows
Own list hygiene tasks: suppressions, sunset flows, deliverability flags, and segment sync issues
Flows & Campaigns
Build and maintain email & SMS flows (welcome, abandon cart/browse, post-purchase, winback, replenishment, etc.) per strategist specs
Execute campaign sends per the content calendar, including audience/segment setup
Implement A/B and multivariate tests (subject lines, send times, content variants) as directed by strategy leads
Update flow logic/triggers when strategists redesign flow architecture
Subscription + Post Purchase Upsells
Configure and maintain post-purchase upsell flows within Shopify third-party apps (ReCharge, AfterSell, Rebuy) as directed by strategy leads
Configure subscription set-up and optimizations for subscriptions within ReCharge, Skio, Loop, and other Shopify apps
Reporting
Pull and organize weekly/monthly performance reports (campaign and flow-level: open rate, CTR, conversion, revenue) per brand
Maintain a standardized reporting template across accounts for easy cross-client comparison
Flag performance anomalies (deliverability drops, flow breakage, sudden metric shifts) proactively
Support ad hoc data pulls for strategist-led analyses (segment performance, cohort data, etc.)
Support client reporting and documentation associated with onboarding and sales audits
2+ years of hands-on production experience in Klaviyo, Postscript, Attentive, or equivalent ESP
Proven experience managing an email list of 100K+ active subscribers
Comfortable working in Figma for template-level edits (no design-from-scratch expected)
DTC/Shopify ecosystem experience — understands product feeds, order data, customer properties as they relate to email/SMS
Experience with post-purchase/upsell apps (Recharge, AfterSell, Rebuy, or similar)
Experience working across multiple client accounts simultaneously
Comfortable with async, overlapping-timezone workflows and clear written communication (Slack/email) with U.S.-based strategists
Competitive Pay: We hire top talent and compensate accordingly.
This is a full-time, long-term engagement with room to grow
The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with TLNT.
100% remote — work from wherever you do your best thinking
Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (+/- 1 hour accepted) - PST.
Additional perks.

En TURBOPAC, empresa líder con más de 10 años de trayectoria en soluciones de Timbrado de CFDI-Validacion CFDI, Provedor Autorizado de Certificacion, estamos buscando una mente creativa y analítica para integrarse a nuestro equipo de crecimiento.

Si te apasiona el ecosistema digital, dominas las métricas y sabes cómo convertir clics en clientes reales, ¡queremos conocerte!

Experiencia: Mínimo 3 años comprobables en gestión de pautas digitales.




Edad sugerida: 25 a 30 años (preferentemente).




Género: Femenino (preferentemente).




Escolaridad: Licenciatura en Marketing, Comunicación, Publicidad o afín.




Presenial 100%




Responsabilidades Clave:




Estrategia Paid Media: Creación, optimización y seguimiento de campañas en Google Ads (Búsqueda y Display) y Meta Ads (Facebook e Instagram).




Social Media Management: Gestión estratégica de redes sociales para aumentar el engagement y la presencia de marca.




Análisis de Datos: Reporteo de KPIs, ROI y ROAS para la toma de decisiones basada en resultados.




Contenido Creativo: Colaboración en la creación de copies y enfoques visuales que conecten con nuestra audiencia B2B.




Administración de pagina web




Requisitos Técnicos:




Dominio avanzado de Business Suite y Google Ads Manager.




Conocimientos en Google Analytics y Pixel de Meta.




Capacidad de redacción impecable y creativa.




Mentalidad orientada a resultados y optimización de presupuestos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Sueldo competitivo (negociable según experiencia).




Prestaciones Superiores a las de la Ley (Fondo de ahorro, vales de despensa, días adicionales de descanso, entre otros).




Estabilidad laboral en una empresa sólida y en expansión.




Excelente ambiente de trabajo en una ubicación privilegiada (Paseo de la Reforma).




Oportunidades de crecimiento y actualización constante.




¿Cómo aplicar?

Si cumples con el perfil y estás lista para llevar el marketing de Go-Offices al siguiente nivel, postúlate por este medio con tu CV actualizado y, de ser posible, un breve portafolio o ejemplos de campañas exitosas que hayas gestionado.







¡Únete al equipo que está transformando la forma de trabajar en México!

description:
About the job

BUILD SOMETHING BIGGER THAN YOURSELF

The Walt Disney Company, together with its subsidiaries and affiliates, is a leading diversified international family entertainment and media enterprise with the following business segments: Disney Entertainment, ESPN, Disney Parks, and Experiences and Products. From humble beginnings as a cartoon studio in the 1920s to its preeminent name in the entertainment industry today, Disney proudly continues its legacy of creating world-class stories and experiences for every member of the family. Disney’s stories, characters and experiences reach consumers and guests from every corner of the globe. With operations in more than 40 countries, our employees and cast members work together to create entertainment experiences that are both universally and locally cherished.

How will you contribute to our magical experience?

The Assistant, Social Media of ESPN Mexico will join the team to maintain our prestige on social networks and will provide our fans with the best consumer experience in sports. This role will be responsible for creating posts (videos, images or text) on our social media channels, generating original and creative content and amplifying the best of our content as a brand in these Social Media platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X. Whether in the office or on-site coverage, the Assistant Social Media will implement our strategy on each social network.

An Assistant of Social Media can contribute by creating or curating relevant, high-quality content that aligns with the brand’s goals, messaging, and audience interests, ensuring the business stays visible and relevant in the digital space.

By consistently creating engaging content and managing the brand’s social presence, a social media assistant can help grow the business’s online following and extend its reach to potential new customers.

The Assistant, Digital ESPN Social Media will be responsible for: 


Implement our social media strategies across the entire brand and propose new ideas to increase our engagement.
Content management across multiple social media platforms including TikTok, Instagram, Facebook and X.
Content creation of video, photos, memes and original content to increase the accounts and engage the fans.
Publish organic content and sales content (paid campaigns).
Live posting of the most important sports events; sometimes the coverage will be on site.
Effective monitoring and content curation.
Identify insights and social media trends.
Collaborate with another teams, especially editorial, DVC and marketing.


What we need from you to be part of this story:


Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or related fields. Qualifications on social media networks are a plus.
Knowledge of social media networks: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X. Ideal experience in social media environment. Knowledge of sports and social media trends. Activate and grow an engaged community.
Basic knowledge in photo and video editing software (Photoshop/CupCut).
Impeccable spelling and writing skills.
Effective monitoring, content curation, teamwork and work under pressure.
Extensive knowledge of sports.
Availability to work evening shifts and weekends, and travel as required.
Upper intermediate level of English.


Additional Information

At Disney, we believe it takes great people to create the memorable experiences, products and services our consumers know and love. We are a team of storytellers and hire under equal opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability and gender identity. We foster a corporate culture of belonging and inclusiveness, which empowers our staff and company to thrive. At Disney, everyone has the opportunity to speak up and participate, grow and share ideas.

“You can design and create, and build the most wonderful place in the world. But it takes people to make the dream a reality.” Walt Disney

description:
About the job

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Associate - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle - translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life


Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients. 
On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns. 
You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages
On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars. 
You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails. 
You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers. 
Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas. 
Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations. 


Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Associate to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.


You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients. 
You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP. 
You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry. 
You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting. 
You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients. 
You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing. 


You should apply if this sounds like you:


2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc. 
Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment. 
Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers. 
Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences. 
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level. 


What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain. 
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. 
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. 


Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace, we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
About the job

About Aplazo

Aplazo is Mexico’s leading “buy now, pay later” platform, giving consumers flexible, transparent payment solutions while helping merchants grow their sales. We’re a fast-growing Series B fintech backed by top global investors, combining technology, data, and design to redefine financial access.

Role’s Mission

Aplazo needs one creative owner who puts ideas on the table and makes sure they ship on-brand. Today that function—concept, narrative, trend judgment, and craft ownership—is split across leadership, the content team, and the agency. This role concentrates it in one person, giving the brand a single voice and a single eye, from idea to final piece.

The Creative & Brand Guardian owns what the brand says and how it looks. You originate the concept and narrative behind campaigns and tentpole moments, and you are the last word on craft—nothing ships that doesn’t meet the bar.

Key Responsibilities

CONCEPT & NARRATIVE


Put ideas on the table — Originate campaign concepts and brand narrative; ideas start here, not just execution.
Own tentpole storytelling — Define the storytelling and creative territory for the brand’s biggest moments of the year.
Set the trend judgment — Decide what the brand jumps on, when, how—and when it doesn’t.
Write briefs that give direction — Translate concept into clear briefs the content and design team can execute against.


BRAND GUARDIANSHIP & CRAFT


Own the design system — Be the steward of the brand book—know it well enough to defend it and evolve it.
Guard visual quality — Review and correct the team’s output before it ships; you are the last word on craft.
Direct the creative work of others — Give creative and design direction to the Content Specialists, correcting with a clear point of view.


This role does not own operations: the calendar, scheduling, and publishing live with Marketing Ops.

Requirements

Must Have


5+ years of experience in art direction, creative direction, or brand design (agency or in-house)
Background in design or art direction—not a pure content strategist; hands-on craft skills are non-negotiable
Proven experience originating campaign concepts and brand narrative end-to-end, not just executing briefs
Strong ownership of design systems—able to defend and evolve a brand book
Fluency in digital/social culture and trend judgment—knows what to jump on and what to skip
Experience directing and correcting the work of designers or content creators
Working proficiency with generative AI tools for creative production
Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Arts, Communication, or a related field (or equivalent demonstrable experience)


Nice to Have


Experience in fintech, retail, or other fast-moving consumer brands
Background managing or briefing external contributors
Motion, video, or art direction for social-first formats
Experience building or evolving a brand book from scratch


Skills

Technical Skills: Art direction, brand systems, campaign concepting, generative AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, etc.), Adobe Creative Suite

Soft Skills: Strong point of view, ability to give and receive critique, cross-functional communication, decisiveness under ambiguity

Languages


Spanish (native/advanced)
English (advanced)


What Success Looks Like


There is a defined visual system that nothing ships without going through—craft consistency across every channel
A tentpole campaign has landed end-to-end, from concept to execution, owned by this role
Dependency on the external creative agency for concept and narrative has dropped measurably
Content Specialists are executing against clear briefs and creative direction, with visible improvement in output quality
The brand has a single, recognizable creative voice across campaigns and everyday content


Pro Tip

How do we review your CV? Help us find you!

We filter applications with the help of AI. To ensure your profile is properly evaluated, we recommend describing your experience using the keywords from this job posting.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with the Privacy Notice of Aplaz, S.A. de C.V. (“Aplazo”), available at our Privacy and Policy Notice.

Aplazo does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, skin color, sex, gender, age, ethnic or national origin, marital status, disability, social or economic status, sexual preferences, or any other condition or characteristic. Selection is based solely on the qualifications and merits of the candidates.

description:
About the job

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Retention Specialist — a strategic, hands-on lifecycle marketer with a proven track record in email and SMS for DTC brands. You'll partner closely with Associate Directors of Retention and cross-functional teams to develop and deploy high-performing campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world — translating data into strategy and strategy into revenue.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life


Lead the execution of email and SMS strategies for a portfolio of DTC/e-commerce clients, working alongside our Associate Directors of Retention to align on goals and priorities. 
Own the end-to-end campaign deployment process - copywriting, briefing, testing, QA, deployment, and performance monitoring. 
Contribute to monthly retention marketing calendars and proactively bring creative campaign concepts to clients and internal teams. 
Lead portions of client calls - presenting content ideas and managing the revision and approval process with confidence. 
Partner with the in-house design team to shape the creative direction of campaigns and flows, ensuring visual and copy are working together to drive results. 
Build, audit, and optimize automation flows, pop-up logic, segmentation strategies, and app integrations. 
Analyze campaign and flow performance and surface actionable recommendations that improve retention KPIs over time. 


Who You Are:

We're looking for a Retention Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.


You have 3-5 years of experience in email and SMS marketing, lifecycle marketing, or CRM — ideally at a DTC-focused agency or in-house at an e-commerce brand. 
You're a Klaviyo power user — flows, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability, and reporting are all in your toolkit. 
You're a strong copywriter who can adapt tone and voice across different brands and audiences. 
You think strategically about the customer journey and know how to use retention levers to drive LTV and reduce churn. 
You’re client-facing and comfortable - you can present a strategy and manage feedback without heavy direction. 
You're highly organized, self-managed, and used to owning multiple accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. 
You have excellent written and verbal English — you communicate with clarity and confidence to both clients and internal stakeholders. 


You should apply if this sounds like you:


You have 3-5 years of experience in email/SMS marketing, growth marketing, or ecommerce CRM. 
You have agency experience or have worked on multiple client accounts simultaneously. 
You're a Klaviyo expert — and have the performance results to back it up. 
You've contributed to client relationships and can present strategy and data to senior stakeholders. 
You're proactive, creative, and hold yourself to a high standard without needing someone to push you. 
You're passionate about DTC, ecommerce, and the evolving landscape of lifecycle marketing. 


What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain. 
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. 
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. 


Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Business Development Representative (BDR) 

Full-Time EST Working Hours | Mastery of English | $2,500+On-Target Earnings 

● Base: $1,500 USD/month | OTE: $2,500 USD/month, paid in USD 




About the Client

Our Client builds ERP software purpose-built for wholesale bakeries, bakery distributors, and large professional retail bakeries, helping them manage orders, production, inventory, and payments in one place. We're growing fast and hiring our first dedicated BDR to help us scale into the North American market. 




The Role 

You'll own the top of the funnel. That means calling wholesale bakery owners and operators across the US, qualifying them, and booking discovery calls for our Account Executive , every day, with discipline and consistency. 

You won't be building the playbook from scratch. We're providing proven call scripts, fully built email sequences, and structured onboarding so you can focus on what actually matters: execution and relationships. What we need from you is the energy, accountability, and people skills to run those plays well and improve on them over time. 




What You'll Do 

● Run daily outbound cold calls and email sequences to wholesale bakery owners, operators, and distributors across the US 

● Use Apollo for prospecting, sequencing, and contact management; HubSpot as your CRM for logging all activity and outcomes 

● Qualify prospects by confirming decision-maker, business scale, and product fit 

● Book qualified discovery calls directly on your Account Executive's calendar 

● Hit weekly targets across dials, live connects, qualified conversations, and meetings booked 

● Join weekly check-ins with Account Executives and Head of Sales 




What We're Looking For 

● English fluency:written and spoken; all prospecting is with US-based business owners. This is a firm requirement. 

● Real cold calling experience, you know what high-volume outreach feels like and you don't shy away from the phone 

● 2–3 years in an SDR, BDR, or sales-adjacent role, ideally in SaaS, software, or tech. Experience selling and booking meetings for B2B software is a must

● Available 9am–5pm EST, Monday–Friday, please be clear-eyed about what this means for your time zone before applying 

● Reliable internet and a quiet, professional space for calls 







This Role Is a Strong Fit If You... 

● Genuinely enjoy cold outreach and find rhythm in high-activity work 

● Are looking for USD compensation with real upside, not a vague bonus structure 

● Want a company that does the enablement work upfront instead of leaving you to figure it out alone 

● You’re looking to build a career in sales and are excited about the opportunity to further refine your skills in a professional environment 




What We Offer 

● Base: $1,500 USD/month | OTE: $2,500+ USD/month, paid in USD 

● Fully remote from anywhere

● Complete sales enablement from day one: scripts, sequences, and structured training 

● Direct mentorship from company leadership 

● Clear growth path as the team scales, this is the first BDR role and we're building around it

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

As a Deployment Strategist, your mission is to connect the dots between user needs, data insights, and product capabilities to help our customers unlock value. You’ll dive deep into our customer operations, partner directly with end users and decision-makers, and shape how HappyRobot’s technology is applied to their most critical challenges.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You Will Do


Partnering with customers to understand their workflows, goals, and pain points—often embedding directly with their teams.
Collaborating with Forward Deployment Engineers to scope, prototype, and deliver solutions powered by HappyRobot’s platform.
Identifying and interpreting key datasets that drive customer decision-making, and working to integrate them into robust, scalable pipelines.
Designing and refining user workflows that solve meaningful problems and scale across teams and functions.
Leading training and onboarding sessions, ensuring new users are set up for success and our tools have lasting impact.
Presenting findings and strategy to stakeholders at all levels—from frontline operators to executives.
Driving customer expansion by scoping new use cases and shaping how we grow our footprint within organizations.


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

The personal data provided in your application and during the selection process will be processed by Happyrobot, Inc., acting as Data Controller.

By sending us your CV, you consent to the processing of your personal data for the purpose of evaluating and selecting you as a candidate for the position. Your personal data will be treated confidentially and will only be used for the recruitment process of the selected job offer.

In relation to the period of conservation of your personal data, these will be eliminated after three months of inactivity in compliance with the GDPR and legislation on the protection of personal data.

If you wish to exercise your rights of access, rectification, deletion, portability or opposition in relation to your personal data, you can do so through security@happyrobot.ai subject to the GDPR.

For more information, visit https://www.happyrobot.ai/privacy-policy

By submitting your request, you confirm that you have read and understood this clause and that you agree to the processing of your personal data as described.

title: AI-First Social Media Coordinator
skills: Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.

Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.
Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.
Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.
You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.
You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.

Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within the Philippines.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

Experiencia trabajando con datos de clientes: limpieza, mapeo, validación y carga de archivos.

Conocimientos técnicos

Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado: tablas dinámicas, BUSCARV/XLOOKUP y transformación de archivos CSV.
Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams)
Herramientas de documentación y gestión de proyectos como Notion y Jira.
Nociones de integraciones entre sistemas (APIs, layouts y archivos de intercambio) y capacidad para dialogar con equipos técnicos.
Redacción de documentación funcional y comunicación escrita profesional.
Facilidad para aprender nuevas plataformas con rapidez.

Idiomas

Español nativo.
Inglés intermedio (B2 o superior) para comunicación escrita con clientes y manejo de documentación y terminología del sector.

Habilidades

Buscamos personas que destaquen por:

Autonomía y ownership: dar seguimiento hasta cerrar.
Organización para gestionar varias implementaciones en paralelo.
Pensamiento analítico y atención al detalle.
Comunicación clara con perfiles operativos y directivos.
Manejo de conversaciones difíciles: expectativas, retrasos y escalamientos.
Priorización y gestión del tiempo en múltiples frentes.
Orientación al cliente y a resultados.
Trabajo colaborativo y adaptabilidad.

Deseable (no indispensable)

Conocimiento de la industria de freight forwarding, comercio exterior, aduanas o cadena de suministro.
Familiaridad con documentos de carga (HAWB/MAWB, cotizaciones, facturación y documentos de cumplimiento).
Experiencia implementando TMS, ERP, WMS u otras plataformas operativas.
Nociones de SQL, análisis de datos o herramientas de BI.
Manejo de herramientas de IA (como Claude, ChatGPT u otros asistentes) para agilizar tareas de documentación, redacción, análisis de datos y resolución de problemas; valoramos saber estructurar buenos prompts y aprovechar la IA de forma crítica y productiva.

Qué buscamos en la persona

Que haga las preguntas correctas y no tenga miedo de entrar en el detalle de un problema.
Que combine empatía con el cliente y rigor operativo: un buen Customer Success Specialist resuelve, pero también documenta y previene.
Que tenga mentalidad de dueño: que dé seguimiento hasta cerrar, no solo hasta delegar.
Que sepa sostener un “todavía no” frente al cliente sin desgastar la relación.




Qué ofrecemos (¿por qué MagicLog?)

Ownership real: Serás responsable de tus cuentas y de tus implementaciones de principio a fin, con autonomía para decidir cómo resolverlas.

Crecimiento profesional: Desarrollarás una combinación poco común de habilidades —producto, datos, operación logística y relación con clientes— con posibilidad de crecer hacia roles de mayor alcance dentro del área.

Impacto directo: Tu trabajo se refleja en la adopción, la satisfacción y la retención de los clientes de una plataforma en plena expansión en LATAM.

Cultura de autonomía: Promovemos un ambiente basado en la confianza, el ownership, la colaboración y la mejora continua.

Trabajo remoto: Esquema completamente remoto, colaborando con equipos distribuidos en la región.

Experiencia en una LogTech internacional: Formarás parte de una empresa que está transformando la industria logística en Latinoamérica mediante tecnología e innovación.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:
We are searching for an Senior Specialist Employee Services to join the Global Business Services (GBS) People & Culture (P&C) team. In this role, the Senior Specialist provides efficient and highly informative first point-of-contact service to all employees, their managers and business partners. 
 
Focused on a seamless customer experience and great customer care, the Senior Specialist uses information from multiple systems and resources to respond to inquiries; provides navigational support to employees on self-service/HR tools such as Workday and ServiceNow and routing/escalating inquiries for advanced support. Using the case management system, the Senior Specialist accurately processes, records, closes or escalates transactions in accordance with established service level agreements. This role collects required information or back-up documentation from employees or external customers. This includes tactfully asking customers probing questions to establish context and ensure the solutions offered or the escalation path is appropriate and most likely to succeed. 
 
The Senior Specialist role provides feedback internally, proposing new and effective ways to resolve problems and improve productivity (i.e., continuous improvement efforts), while maintaining broad knowledge of policies, procedures, and resources. 
 
Your Role Accountabilities:

Analyze and resolve different types of requests from employees or clients.
Handle inbound requests via phone, email, the HR-Portal, or other access channels. 
Perform individual employee data transactions and data-entry in Workday and other systems. 
Troubleshoot payroll and time off inquiries, recalculations, employment verifications (VOE/VOIs), direct deposit setups, pay and tax document re-issues, data updates, etc. 
Provide support for self-service and P&C technology tools for employees and customers. 
Ensure completeness of case notes, aligning with company and audit expectations.
Assisting customers to increase awareness of self-service resources and promote self-sufficiency. 
Ensure confidentiality information when processing transactions and addressing employee inquiries. 
Perform and track administrative (no call) departmental tasks, including report reviewing, data updates, mailing, filing, sending correspondence, and records management. 

 
Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field
Fluent in English 
Experience with Human Resources administrative or related experience required, preferably with supervisory responsibilities from a global entertainment environment.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality and use confidential information appropriately.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! Vonage Communications APIs:

As an emerging leader in the $10B+ communications API market, we empower global brands to connect better with their customers, employees, and partners through transformative communications experiences. For example, Vonage API solutions empower organizations to build their custom omnichannel communications structure. This allows them to reach and engage customers on their preferred schedule and channel — including voice, video, and messaging. Think of a rideshare service instantly connecting with customers, hospital staff conducting remote monitoring, customers verifying their identity before completing a purchase, AI virtual agents servicing customers around the clock, and much more.

Why this role matters:

Our Customer Success Training Specialist will provide the foundational learning for our Customer Success teams. In this role you will be the architect of the CS journey, from the moment a new CSM joins to the mastery of our post-sales ecosystem.

Your key responsibilities:
End-to-End Onboarding: Design and lead a world-class onboarding program that gets new CSMs up to speed on our product, our customers, and our unique approach to partnership.

What you’ll bring:

To be successful in this role, you should be a blend of an educator, a strategist, and a Customer Success advocate. We are looking for someone who understands that CS is both an art and a science. 

Required:

CS Enablement Background: 2–4 years of experience in Customer Success training and enablement. If you’ve previously carried a book of business as a CSM, that’s a major plus.

Methodology Knowledge: A background in MEDDPICC or similar sales/success methodologies is a significant advantage.
Where you will work:

This position offers a fully remote work arrangement based out of Mexico.

Sponsorship is not available. Legal authorization to work in Mexico is required. We are unable to sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. 

 

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. Disminuimos el churn con estrategias inteligentes y personalizadas.
Recuperamos clientes entendiendo su negocio y sus necesidades reales.
Convertimos incidencias de pago y fricción en experiencias positivas.
Aseguramos que cada especialista aproveche al máximo la plataforma.

Analizar las razones de posible baja de especialistas y diseñar estrategias personalizadas para su retención, alineando sus necesidades con las soluciones que ofrece Doctoralia.

Experiencia: De 1 a 2 años en Retención y seguimiento de Carteras con alto volumen de clientes. (100-150 clientes).
ADN Tech: Te mueves como pez en el agua en entornos Startup, Marketing o Publicidad.

description:
About the job

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique:

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 




How You'll Make an Impact:

As a leader within the Customer Onboarding Team, you will cultivate a highly effective, close-knit, and collaborative team that consistently delivers exceptional support. By ensuring seamless and successful onboarding experiences, your leadership directly translates into immediate value realization and long-term retention for our customers.




In this role, you will champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission, guiding your team to move from a pure training function to a strategic business partnership. You will lead a group of Caring Rebels who model Hospitality Before Efficiency, empowering clients to use our platform to deliver an experience of Unreasonable Hospitality. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and are ready to make a significant impact by guiding, mentoring, and setting the standard for a deeply personalized customer journey, we look forward to having you lead the way!




Our Customer Onboarding Team:

Our Onboarding team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time on our "human magic": building and strengthening relationships, and ensuring our customers feel confident and supported from day one. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational tasks, you and your team will feel right at home here.




What You Bring to the Team:

• Embody the Caring Rebel Mindset: 

Cultivate, mentor, motivate, and empower a world-class team of Onboarding Coaches to care for our customers and their properties just as they would for a guest in a hotel.




• Standardize the Repeatable, Personalize the Meaningful:

 Drive the adoption of AI and modern tooling across your team to eliminate administrative drag, freeing them up to focus on strategic onboarding guidance, deep product adoption, and human magic.




• Lead Performance & Growth:

 Own the preparation, execution, and follow-up for 1-on-1s, check-ins, and performance reviews. Identify, communicate, and facilitate learning and career-growth opportunities for each member of your team.




• Strategic Portfolio Management:

 Monitor a segment of Cloudbeds customers with associated retention goals, analyzing utilization and customer data independently to discover insights and improve the onboarding experience.




• Escalation & Advocacy:

 Serve as a confident, knowledgeable, and patient escalation point for complex technical or operational inquiries from clients, third-party stakeholders, and key decision-makers.




• Cross-Functional Collaboration:

 Partner with Sales, Product, and Support to convert onboarding feedback into systemic operational improvements, shortening delivery timeframes and ensuring Cloudbeds' value is realized early.




• Thought Leadership:

 Provide leadership in hospitality training, ensuring full client context is maintained throughout the journey, and that all new knowledge is captured, searchable, and reusable.




• Commercial Mindset:

 Partner with Sales to define success, demonstrate ROI, drive customer retention, promote product value, and identify upsell opportunities.




• Data-Driven Success:

 Design, implement, and track quantitative and qualitative metrics to measure the success of projects, people, and processes, including driving best practices around customer outreach for reviews.




What Sets You Up for Success:

• Show Strong AI Smarts: 

Exceptional technical aptitude and learning agility. You work seamlessly with AI, pick up new software quickly, and feel comfortable adapting to evolving technology to unlock more time for personalized relationships.




• Demonstrate Your Hospitality Heart:

 Over 2 years of direct leadership experience within a hospitality property (e.g., Front Desk Manager, Revenue Manager, Concierge) or at least 3 years of relevant Hospitality SaaS industry experience in a customer-facing leadership/matrix role. (Prior experience as a Senior or Key Account Onboarding Coach within Cloudbeds is a major plus).




• Empathy & Relationship Champion: 

High emotional intelligence with a proven ability to build trust, resolve competing priorities under pressure, and create relationships across all levels of an organization (internally and externally).




• Agile Leadership:

 Ability to manage people, processes, and accounts effectively in an agile system and matrix reporting environment, while overseeing comprehensive learning and development plans for your team.




• Clear Communicator: 

Ability to clearly, concisely, and confidently synthesize technical and business concepts in both written and verbal contexts.




• Operational Excellence: 

Highly accountable, data-driven, and detail-oriented with background experience in modern operating systems (CRMs like Salesforce, OTAs, PMS backgrounds, etc.).




• Inclusive Outlook: 

Comfortable leading and working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds.




Recommended Skills to Stand Out:

1. Fluency or working knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, English, Thai, or Tagalog.

2. Project Management or Change Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Prosci).

3. Hospitality degree preferred.




What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. 




Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. If you're ready to work alongside some of the brightest minds in tech who are obsessed with using AI to transform a trillion-dollar industry, this is your chance to be part of something extraordinary.

Learn more online at cloudbeds.com

title: CX Operations Specialist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un Customer Experience Operations Specialist (CX Operations Specialist) para una operación de atención que corre en tres mercados.




Es una posición de operaciones de experiencia del cliente: encontrar por qué la gente contacta, agrupar por causa raíz y convertir ese hallazgo en una automatización, un requerimiento de desarrollo o una mejora de producto. Y darle seguimiento hasta que se implemente.




🎯 Qué vas a hacer

- Analizar casos, contactos y conversaciones de los tres mercados agrupándolos por causa raíz, no por síntoma.

- Construir, publicar y mantener los indicadores de causa: volumen y motivo de contacto, recontacto, tiempo de resolución, escalaciones y concentración por proveedor o método de pago.

- Llevar los hallazgos a quien puede corregirlos (Producto, Marketing, Ingeniería, entre otros) con evidencia de la operación, y darles seguimiento hasta la corrección o una decisión documentada.

- Administrar y configurar las plataformas del área (flujos, disparadores, automatizaciones, formularios, vistas y reportes), con la configuración documentada.

- Automatizar lo repetitivo, incluida la gestión del asistente automatizado: alcances, contención de casos y calidad de respuestas.

- Traducir la necesidad operativa en requerimientos con criterios de aceptación, priorizar el backlog, destrabar dependencias y validar cada implementación antes de cerrarla.




🛠️ Con qué vas a trabajar

- Plataforma de atención a clientes: configuración de flujos, automatizaciones, disparadores y reportes.

- Datos crudos de la operación para construir indicadores desde cero.

- Asistentes automatizados y herramientas de análisis y automatización del área.




🔍 Qué necesitamos de ti

- Dos años o más en operaciones de atención a clientes, soporte, helpdesk u operaciones similares, o en análisis de información operativa.

- Haber configurado una plataforma operativa (atención a clientes, CRM, ticketing, automatización o similar): flujos, automatizaciones, disparadores y reportes.

- Construir indicadores desde datos crudos, identificar causas raíz y presentar conclusiones accionables.

- Experiencia levantando requerimientos técnicos hacia desarrollo y dando seguimiento hasta la implementación.

- Licenciatura concluida en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Administración, Actuaría o afín.




🧠 Cómo trabajamos

- Los hallazgos no se quedan en el aire: cada análisis termina en algo implementado o en una decisión documentada.

- Vas a resolver la configuración de la plataforma con autonomía técnica, dentro de la política de accesos y validando con Cumplimiento lo que aplique.

- Cuando otra área bloquea algo, escalas con una propuesta y consigues el avance.

- Los requerimientos se escriben con criterios claros para que se implementen sin retrabajos.




📍 Dónde y por qué

- Presencial en Monterrey, Nuevo León

- Tiempo completo

- Coordinas con customer care y con desarrollo

- Vas a trabajar de cerca con Producto, Marketing, Ingeniería y Cumplimiento

Build and maintain strong relationships through regular customer interactions, formal feedback surveys, and tailored meetings.
Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams to resolve escalations, propose solutions, and drive process improvements.
Process customer orders, changes, returns, and quotes in SAP
Review and ensure compliance with customer terms, quality requirements, and contractual obligations.
Oversee scheduling agreements, monitor critical shipments, and expedite orders as required.
Drive initiatives for Extraordinary Customer Experience (ECE) and satisfaction metrics like CES, FCR, and NPS.
Conduct root-cause analysis of issues and implement corrective actions to improve service delivery.
Identify opportunities for streamlining processes and execute small improvement projects.
