Investigate and resolve customer issues related to delivery, price, and quality.
Collaborate with Key Account Managers and other stakeholders to meet on-time delivery and operational goals.

Participate in training sessions, process improvement initiatives, and cross-departmental projects.
Mentor and support new team members to enhance team capabilities.

About the job

This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

The Field Marketing Manager will manage demand generation efforts in Mexico, and build a robust marketing pipeline across a number of channels, including events, digital and partnerships. This role will report directly to our VP of Marketing, LatAm. The ideal candidate is an effective leader with proven management skills and proven experience leading acquisition efforts. You are data-driven and have a proven ability to develop, track and scale new marketing initiatives across all channels. This is a highly matrixed role collaborating across the LatAm and Global Marketing teams to deliver efficient acquisition strategy and tactics.

What You’ll Do


Design and manage our acquisition marketing strategy in Mexico to ensure that objectives are met to maximum efficiency. 
Set and track our pipeline generation goals and ensure that we deliver a positive ROI in the region. 
Build a fully integrated acquisition plan, from consideration to demand generation, including advertising, online paid acquisition, events, ABM, Partnership activities & SOW. 
Partner with the Sales Team on our commercial strategy and work cross functionally on ABM and pipeline generation. 
Optimize our ROI and budget to reach our targets. Work on increasing our Lead quality and conversion rate. Find new, innovative ways to increase lead generation. 
Own budgeting and forecasting for acquisition, track budget spent, report in ROI and Cost per Acquisition. 
Work closely with our VP of Marketing and Global Marketing team to scale our LatAm activities, predict revenue and build our acquisition engine. 


Who You Are


8+ years of proven experience in marketing. 
Strong background in demand generation through physical and digital activities. 
Proven analytical mindset. Ability to tell a story with data, articulate what’s working and what’s not, and set a clear path for data-driven optimizations. 
Proven experience delivering creative and successful marketing campaigns to build pipeline generation. 
Ability to create and maintain relationships with stakeholders. 
Ability to travel domestically and internationally. 
Strong Communicator- Exceptional stakeholder and relationship management skills, with full professional proficiency (written and verbal) in English and Spanish. 


Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

This role is based in our Mexico City office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

description:
About the job

Brand Manager – Teamfight Tactics 

Brand Management at Riot is focused on players and fans. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and creating meaningful experiences across every touchpoint. For Teamfight Tactics, this means celebrating the strategy, creativity, and competitive mastery at the heart of the game while growing a passionate global community around it.

As a Brand Manager II for Teamfight Tactics, you will primarily lead publishing and brand marketing efforts for TFT Esports (approx. 80% of your scope) while supporting broader TFT publishing initiatives and evergreen brand priorities (approx. 20%). You'll help strengthen TFT's competitive identity through integrated campaigns, compelling storytelling, and player-first experiences that celebrate the game's global esports ecosystem. 80% Esports / 20% Game

This is a highly collaborative role that works across Creative, Communications, Social, Regional Publishing, Esports Product, Broadcast, Community, and Production teams to deliver impactful campaigns that grow fandom and support business outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing and this role can be based in Mexico city or LAX.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Campaign Leadership


Steward the TFT Esports brand by developing marketing and communications strategies that strengthen its competitive identity and deepen player fandom.
Lead integrated global marketing campaigns for esports events, tournaments, and competitive moments, from brief through launch, measurement, and retrospective.
Translate player and audience insights into compelling creative briefs, campaign strategies, and marketing plans.
Support broader TFT publishing initiatives throughout the year, contributing to game campaigns and evergreen brand priorities beyond the esports calendar.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Global Publishing


Partner with Esports Product, Broadcast, Competitive Operations, Social, Community, Influencer, and Regional Publishing teams to develop aligned global marketing plans.
Partner with regional publishing teams by providing creative frameworks, marketing assets, and best practices that enable locally relevant execution while maintaining global brand consistency.
Collaborate with Insights, Business Development, Product, and Live Experiences teams to identify opportunities that strengthen the TFT player experience and esports ecosystem.


Creative & Operational Excellence


Steward creative development across esports marketing initiatives, ensuring work reflects TFT's brand, competitive spirit, and player experience.
Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agency relationships, and production partners to deliver high-quality work that is on strategy, on time, and on budget.
Stay closely connected to the TFT community, competitive scene, and broader gaming landscape to identify emerging opportunities and inform future marketing initiatives.


Required Qualifications


3 to 5 years of experience in brand management, product marketing, community marketing, or agency roles within gaming, entertainment, or esports.
Deep understanding of the TFT esports landscape and a nuanced grasp of the players, fans, creators, and communities that shape its competitive ecosystem.
Experience developing and executing integrated marketing and communications campaigns from planning through launch.
Strong understanding of brand fundamentals and experience translating player or audience insights into effective marketing strategies.
Experience working with gaming audiences, live events, or community-driven marketing initiatives.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional and international teams to deliver shared goals.
Experience working with agencies, creative partners, or production teams to bring campaigns to life.
Experience using campaign performance data and audience insights to evaluate campaign performance and optimize future marketing efforts.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.


Desired Qualifications


Familiarity with Teamfight Tactics, Riot Games' portfolio, or competitive strategy games.
Experience partnering with esports product, broadcast, live event production, or game development teams.
Understanding of creative production workflows and integrated global marketing campaigns.
Awareness of emerging trends across gaming, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle marketing.
Active TFT player and engaged member of the TFT community.


You have strong marketing instincts, enjoy collaborating across disciplines, and care deeply about creating campaigns that resonate with players and fans. You balance creativity with thoughtful execution and are motivated by delivering experiences that strengthen TFT's competitive identity and long-term fandom.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Perks: Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k/Private Pension Plan with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Duties

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:


Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters


These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

description:
About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

title: Marketing Manager, Campaign Management
skills: Standardizing Campaign Processes: Implement and enforce a unified set of campaign execution process flows and best practices across all teams and regions, so that every marketing campaign (from planning to launch to post-campaign reporting) follows the same playbook. This involves defining clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), service-level agreements (SLAs) for deliverables, and quality checkpoints. The goal is to ensure every campaign is executed efficiently and “on time, on brand, and on budget”, regardless of which team or region runs it. The Manager will administer quality control over all campaign projects, verifying that essential steps (briefs, reviews, approvals, etc.) are completed for each campaign. They also continuously refine processes to improve speed (“speed to market”) without sacrificing quality or consistency.
Leadership & Team Management: Provide strong leadership, coaching, and direction to 10 Campaign Managers.

Financial Discipline & MDF Management: A critical part of the role is financial oversight of campaign budgets and Marketing Development Funds (MDF). The manager will track all campaign budgets and vendor-provided funds, ensuring budget accuracy, timely utilization, and full compliance with funding requirements. They establish a “zero-tolerance” policy for letting allocated MDF expire unused – which is essential since many vendor funds expire if not utilized within a set timeframe (often 12 months).

Operational Excellence & Capacity Management: Manage the overall campaign production pipeline and capacity planning. With 20+ reports handling numerous simultaneous campaigns, the leader must allocate resources optimally across teams, balancing workloads and adjusting assignments when high-priority projects or “crunch times” arise. They will use tools (like Workfront) and data to monitor each team’s capacity and productivity, ensuring no team is overloaded and that campaigns are delivered per the agreed timeline.

Marketing Technology/Operations team to ensure that systems like Workfront, CRM, and analytics tools are configured to support campaign processes and reporting needs (for instance, integrating Workfront with financial systems like Anaplan or Oracle to sync budget data automatically).

Performance Tracking & ROI Accountability: Ensure that campaign outcomes are measured and communicated in terms of business impact. The Manager will oversee the development of standardized reporting dashboards and processes so that each campaign manager (and their stakeholders) can easily see key metrics like lead volumes, conversion rates through the funnel, pipeline generated, and ROI for their campaigns.
10 years in Marketing Ops, Project Management, or Agency Account Leadership.
5+ years managing large, multi-functional teams (10+ people)
Experience with MDF/Co-op funding and vendor-partner marketing models.

Beyond just using tools, understand API integrations between Work Management (Workfront), CRM (Salesforce/Dynamics), and Marketing Automation (Marketo/HubSpot). Know how data flows from a "Brief" to a "Lead" to a "Financial Claim.
Hands-on experience with enterprise financial software (e.g., Oracle, SAP, or Anaplan) to track MDF allocations, net margins, and cost recovery.
Technical understanding of multi-touch attribution (MTA) to ensure the ROI reported to vendors and leadership is accurate and defensible.
Experience managing Internationalization (i18n) and Localization (l10n) workflows is a huge plus. Know how a campaign flow changes when moving from North America to EMEA or LATAM.
Experience with Marketing Development Funds (MDF) "push back" on vendors regarding proof-of-performance requirements or negotiate better funding terms based on the ROI data they’ve collected.
The ideal candidate has a proven framework for triage—deciding which campaigns get resources when capacity is peaked.

description:
About the job

About Us

At WeWork, we provide flexible workspace solutions to help businesses of all sizes thrive in more than 37 countries worldwide. The future of work is here, and we’re not just a part of that movement—we’re leading it. United by a desire to build a global community, our purpose is to give members the support to do their best work, and the space to take their ideas to new heights. Join us as we empower tomorrow’s world at work.

About The Role

WeWork is looking for a strategic, analytical, and highly collaborative Senior Manager, Global Field Marketing to help drive marketing performance across our global portfolio. Based in Mexico City and part of WeWork’s Global Marketing team, this role will sit at the intersection of global marketing strategy, regional marketing, and property-level execution, helping ensure our marketing efforts translate into measurable business impact across markets.

The Senior Manager, Global Field Marketing will partner closely with regional marketing leaders and cross-functional teams to develop and evolve the frameworks, programs, and insights that enable strong field marketing around the world. A critical part of the role will be developing a deep understanding of global and regional marketing performance—identifying trends, opportunities, and areas of underperformance and translating those insights into actionable recommendations for regional teams and the broader Global Marketing organization.

This individual will also help strengthen our approach to property marketing, ensuring marketing strategies reflect the needs of individual buildings, neighborhoods, and markets while remaining connected to broader regional and global priorities. The role requires someone who can move fluidly between strategy and execution, understand both portfolio-level and property-level business needs, and bring structure and consistency to marketing across a complex, global organization.

Success in this role will require strong commercial instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence across markets and functions without always having direct ownership of execution.

Global & Regional Marketing Strategy


Partner with Global Marketing leadership and regional marketing teams to translate company priorities and business needs into actionable regional and field marketing strategies that drive demand, member acquisition, retention, and revenue.
Establish a consistent global approach to field marketing while allowing for the flexibility required to address local market dynamics, customer needs, and commercial priorities.
Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Sales, Revenue, Real Estate, Community, Operations, and other key stakeholders to ensure marketing strategies are grounded in business priorities.
Connect insights and best practices across regions, identifying opportunities to scale successful programs, campaigns, and approaches globally.
Support annual and quarterly marketing planning, helping regional teams prioritize initiatives and investments based on business opportunity and expected impact.
Lead and develop a high-performing team while providing guidance and mentorship across the broader regional marketing organization.


Marketing Performance & Business Insights


Develop a comprehensive understanding of global and regional marketing performance, including the key drivers of performance across markets, channels, audiences, and properties.
Partner with regional teams and Global Marketing to define and monitor key performance indicators and build consistent reporting that provides visibility into marketing performance at the global, regional, market, and property levels.
Analyze marketing and business performance to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and the "why" behind performance, combining quantitative data with local market context to develop actionable recommendations.
Translate performance insights into clear narratives and recommendations for Global Marketing leadership, regional teams, and senior cross-functional stakeholders.
Partner with Finance and regional stakeholders to evaluate marketing investment, effectiveness, and ROI and help direct resources toward the highest-impact opportunities.


Regional & Property Marketing


Partner with regional Marketing, Sales, Real Estate, Design, and Operations teams to develop strategies that address market- and property-specific business needs, including new openings, occupancy opportunities, competitive pressures, product priorities, and other commercial objectives.
Evolve WeWork’s global approach to property marketing, creating scalable frameworks, playbooks, and best practices that regional teams can adapt to individual markets and buildings.
Identify priority properties and markets where focused marketing investment can have the greatest business impact, informed by customer insights, competitive dynamics, sales needs, property performance, and broader market conditions.
Support the development of localized campaigns, activations, partnerships, events, and other programs designed to generate awareness and demand for specific properties or portfolios.


Demand Generation & Integrated Marketing


Partner across Global Marketing channels—including Email, Social, Content/Editorial, Communications, Events, Partnerships, and Paid—to ensure regional and property-level needs are reflected in global programs and campaigns.
Help regional teams effectively leverage and localize global campaigns, messaging, creative assets, and channels while identifying where market-specific programs are required.
Support integrated marketing programs across the full customer journey, from awareness and consideration through lead generation and conversion.
Partner with digital and growth teams to identify opportunities to improve local paid media, SEO, web conversion, CRM, and other demand-generation efforts.
Ensure field marketing programs have clear objectives, target audiences, measurement plans, and connections to commercial outcomes.


About You


Bachelors Degree in Marketing or related
10+ years of marketing experience, with a strong background in regional, field, integrated, or growth marketing within a global or multi-market organization.
Demonstrated experience translating global marketing strategies into effective regional and local execution, balancing consistency with local market needs.
Strong understanding of marketing performance and measurement, with the ability to identify business drivers, interpret data, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
Strong commercial orientation, with an understanding of how marketing contributes to demand, pipeline, occupancy, revenue, and other business outcomes.
Experience with property, location-based, retail, hospitality, real estate, or other distributed/physical-location marketing strongly preferred.
Exceptional cross-functional and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across geographies, functions, and levels of seniority.
Strategic and solutions-oriented thinker who is equally comfortable being hands-on and driving execution in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information and clearly communicate recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Given the global nature of the role, flexibility to work across a variety of time zones and occasionally outside of standard local business hours is required.
Fluency in English required; Spanish and/or Portuguese fluency strongly preferred.


Life at WeWork

Being a WeWorker is more than just a job. We believe the magic of work is sparked by the passion you bring, the places you go, the people you meet and the purpose you follow. And it starts here. Here you will brush shoulders with those who dare to dream and do. Here you will be welcomed by a community that embraces and inspires you—because together we can achieve more. Here we challenge ideas, and explore new ways of getting things done. Whether you are part of our Employee Community Groups, or part of a global project, we ask you to bring your open-minded attitude and collaborative spirit. In return, you will be part of a team where your unique perspectives are celebrated.

description:
About the job

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Merchant Care Analyst I is the foundational tier within our Merchant Care organisation, responsible for delivering efficient and timely responses to merchant inquiries. You will support tickets raised by merchants through any channel, instant messaging, email or web form, as well as requests from internal stakeholders, ensuring queries are addressed promptly and accurately within a specific product scope. The role combines resolving documented issues independently using our established knowledge base with recognising cases of higher complexity and escalating them with clear context to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst. Success in this role means strong communication, a solid understanding of payments, and a genuine sense of urgency in everything you pick up.

What You Will Be Doing


Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system, remaining logged in and active during working hours.
Investigate and respond to merchant inquiries, as well as requests from internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.
Perform initial investigations and refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate, providing full context for a speedy resolution.
Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation up to date.
Maintain a solid understanding of our products, services, and policies to provide accurate information to merchants.
Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimise errors and deliver consistent care.
Categorise issues in the global queue and identify repetitive problems, escalating likely root causes to the wider team.
Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with our Product and Engineering teams.
Participate actively in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.


About You


2+ years of experience in technical support or operations roles, ideally within Fintech, Banking or Financial Services.
A degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Data or a related field, though equivalent professional experience in other disciplines will be considered.
A comprehensive understanding of the end-to-end payment flow
Strong problem-solving skills, breaking a merchant-reported symptom into checkable components and working through them methodically rather than by trial and error.
Proficient in one or more of the following: API troubleshooting with Postman, log and event analysis with Datadog, data querying with Looker, Snowflake or SQL, and secure environment access tooling such as Guacamole.
Comfortable following SOPs and troubleshooting guides accurately, and knowing which tool applies to which category of task.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to interpret complex technical issues in simple business terms for merchants and non-technical stakeholders.
Able to manage a live workload against SLA countdowns in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high service standards.
Proficiency in using customer service software (e.g. Zendesk, Salesforce) and CRM tools.
Proven ability to work independently as well as collaborate effectively across teams, seeking guidance proactively to ensure positive outcomes for merchants.
A genuine appetite for learning new concepts and technologies quickly, approaching all work with urgency, enthusiasm and a growth mindset.


Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.




Working Pattern

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

LexisNexis Legal & Professional® provides legal, regulatory, and business information and analytics that help customers increase their productivity, improve decision-making, achieve better outcomes, and advance the rule of law around the world. description:
About the job

¿Has dirigido la urbanización completa de un desarrollo, desde terracerías hasta la energización de la red eléctrica? Esta vacante es para ti 👇




Buscamos Gerente de Urbanización para una desarrolladora de vivienda con base en Mérida, Yucatán.

No es supervisar una obra: es dirigir toda la infraestructura que hace posible que un desarrollo se pueda construir, vender y entregar.




🎯 Objetivo del puesto

Planear, dirigir, coordinar y supervisar la ejecución de las obras de urbanización de los desarrollos habitacionales, cumpliendo programa, presupuesto, normatividad y estándares de calidad y seguridad, para garantizar la entrega oportuna de la infraestructura.




🔧 Lo que vas a hacer

• Elaborar y dar seguimiento al programa maestro de urbanización de cada desarrollo

• Supervisar terracerías, pavimentos, redes de agua, drenaje, red eléctrica, alumbrado y obras complementarias

• Controlar avances físicos y financieros, y validar estimaciones de contratistas

• Coordinar la liberación de frentes para la construcción de vivienda

• Gestionar la relación con organismos operadores y autoridades para la entrega de infraestructura

• Liderar a tu equipo de residentes, supervisores y coordinadores de control de obra




✅ Indispensable

• Ingeniería Civil, Ingeniería en Construcción o Arquitectura (con amplia experiencia en urbanización), titulado(a)

• Mínimo 8 años de experiencia en construcción de infraestructura urbana

• Al menos 5 años en puestos de supervisión o gerencia

• Experiencia comprobable en desarrollos habitacionales de gran escala

• Conocimiento de procesos de urbanización en Yucatán

 • Manejo de AutoCAD y plataformas BIM

• Disponibilidad para trasladarte entre desarrollos en Mérida y atender imprevistos fuera de horario cuando la operación lo requiera




⭐ Deseable

• Programación de obra en MS Project o Primavera

• Residir en Mérida, Yucatán.




¿Qué se te ofrece?

Salario neto mensual entre $50,000 MXN y $62,000 MXN dependiendo de tu experiencia previa, conocimientos técnicos y competencias de liderazgo.
Prestaciones de ley y superiores.
Jornada de Lunes a Viernes.
